name: ham-radio-lookup
description: Search FCC amateur radio licenses and RadioID DMR IDs.

scripts.pack:linux-x64: node ./node_modules/@electron/packager/bin/electron-packager.mjs . "Ham Radio Lookup" --platform=linux --arch=x64 --out=dist --overwrite && node bin/linux-launcher.js x64
scripts.pack:linux-arm64: node ./node_modules/@electron/packager/bin/electron-packager.mjs . "Ham Radio Lookup" --platform=linux --arch=arm64 --out=dist --overwrite && node bin/linux-launcher.js arm64
